game_info.title: Star Wars Rules & Lore Database
game_info.description: Synthesized rules from major Star Wars tabletop games: Legion, X-Wing, Rebellion, Force & Destiny RPG, and Star Wars: Unlimited
source_games: Star Wars: Legion (Atomic Mass Games, 2015, Refresh 2024)
Star Wars: X-Wing Miniatures Game (FFG, 2012, 2nd Ed 2018)
Star Wars: Force and Destiny RPG (FFG, 2015)

ground_combat.description: Miniatures-based ground combat with alternating activations and command cards

command_phase.description: Both players secretly select a command card, then reveal and resolve effects. Priority is determined by comparing pip values.
steps: Each player selects a command card from their hand and places it face-down
Both players reveal command cards simultaneously
Resolve command card effects
Compare pip values to determine priority
The priority player issues orders first

activation_phase.description: Units are activated in order determined by command cards and order pools. Each activation includes movement and attacks.
steps: Draw order tokens from order pools
Activate units based on order tokens: Move, then Attack
Units with Standby tokens wait for later activation
Continue until all order pools are depleted and all units have face-down order tokens
Resolve start of end phase effects
Score victory points from objective cards
Discard revealed command cards
Remove green tokens (Aim, Dodge, Observation, Surge, Standby)
Remove one suppression token from each unit
Advance round counter

unit_ranks.commander: Elite leaders with unique command cards
unit_ranks.corps: Standard line units forming the backbone of armies
unit_ranks.support: Support units providing buffs and utility
unit_ranks.heavy: Heavy weapons and vehicles with high firepower

attack_rules.description: Attacks use dice pools modified by range, cover, and unit abilities
steps: Attacker declares target unit within range and line of sight
Roll attack dice based on weapon profile and range band
Defender rolls defense dice based on Agility stat
Resolve results: Hits and Glances cause damage, Crits cause extra effects
Apply damage to shields first, then hull

dice_types.red: Attack dice — produces Hits, Glances, Crits, and Blanks
dice_types.yellow: Defense dice — produces Evades, Shields, and Blanks

movement.description: Units move up to their Speed stat in inches per activation

terrain.heavy_cover: Grants +2 defense dice and blocks line of sight
terrain.difficult: Hinders movement; units must stop if they end in difficult terrain

suppression.description: Units can be suppressed, reducing their effectiveness. Suppression tokens are removed during the end phase.
suppression.effects: Suppressed units may have reduced attack or defense capabilities

space_combat.description: Tactical ship-to-ship dogfighting with secret maneuver planning

planning_phase.description: Each player secretly chooses one maneuver for each ship using its maneuver dial, placing dials face-down.
steps: For each ship, select a maneuver from the ship's dial
Place the dial face-down next to the ship

activation_phase.description: Ships move and perform one action, in ascending order of pilot skill.
steps: Reveal each ship's maneuver dial in ascending pilot skill order
Execute the chosen maneuver
Ship may perform one action (barrel roll, boost, evade, focus, lock, reload, etc.)

combat_phase.description: Each ship may perform one attack, in descending order of pilot skill.
steps: Attacker declares target within firing arc and range
Roll attack dice modified by range and abilities
Defender rolls defense dice modified by Agility and actions
Resolve hits: assign damage cards to defending ship
Critical hits reveal damage cards face-up for ongoing effects

end_phase.description: Cleanup: remove unused action tokens (except target locks) and resolve end phase abilities.
steps: Remove focus, evade, and reload tokens
Resolve end phase card abilities

ship_statistics.agility: Number of defense dice the target rolls
ship_statistics.hull: Structural integrity; absorbs damage after shields are depleted
ship_statistics.shields: Energy barrier; absorbs damage before hull
ship_statistics.firing_arc: Front arc (most ships) or full arc (some ships)

firing_arcs.front_arc: 120-degree arc in front of the ship

damage_system.description: Ships receive damage cards when hit. Face-down cards are stress or hidden damage; face-up cards are critical hits with ongoing effects.
damage_system.critical_hit: Reveals a damage card face-up, imposing a lasting penalty until repaired

galaxy_control.description: Asymmetric galaxy-scale strategy game for two players

assignment_phase.description: Players assign leaders to missions secretly.
steps: Each player assigns leaders to mission cards
Leaders are placed face-down on missions

command_phase.description: Players take turns resolving missions or placing leaders on the board to move units and start combats.
steps: Players alternate taking actions
Actions include: resolve missions, place leaders, move ships, move ground units, initiate combat
Phase ends when both players pass consecutively

refresh_phase.description: Cleanup steps: retrieve leaders, draw missions, launch probe droids, draw objectives, recruit leaders, build units.
steps: Retrieve leaders from the board and missions
Draw mission cards (2 per player)
Imperial player launches probe droids (2 probe cards)
Rebel player draws 1 objective card
Recruit new leaders if time track allows
Build new units if time track allows

imperial_win: Conquer the Rebel base system (Imperial units present, no Rebel units)
Death Star destroys the system containing the Rebel base
rebel_win: Reputation marker meets or passes the time marker on the time track
Time track reaches its end without the Empire finding the base

time_track.description: 16 spaces maximum. Time marker starts at 1 and advances each round. Reputation marker starts at 14 and moves toward time as Rebels complete objectives.
time_track.rebel_mechanic: Rebels gain reputation by fulfilling objective card requirements
time_track.imperial_mechanic: Empire advances time by completing projects and building superweapons

probe_droids.description: Imperial player draws probe cards each round to eliminate possible Rebel base locations. Each probe reveals 1 system where the base is NOT located.
probe_droids.purpose: Gradually narrow down the hidden Rebel base location

space_combat.description: Dice-based combat using tactic cards. Players draw or play tactic cards to modify dice rolls.
steps: Attacker declares combat
Both players draw or play tactic cards
Roll dice based on ship attack values
Apply hits to ship shields and hull

ground_combat.description: Dice-based combat using ground tactic cards to determine system loyalty.
steps: Attacker declares ground combat
Both players draw or play ground tactic cards
Roll dice based on ground unit values
Winner gains loyalty in the system

rpg_mechanics.source: Star Wars: Force and Destiny (FFG Narrative Dice)
rpg_mechanics.description: Narrative dice pool system for roleplaying adventures

core_mechanic.description: Build and roll a dice pool. Results are interpreted using four symbol pairs.

symbol_pairs.success_failure: Determines whether the action succeeds or fails
symbol_pairs.advantage_threat: Side effects — Advantage helps the actor, Threat helps the opponent
symbol_pairs.triumph_despair: Major narrative effects — Triumph is a huge bonus, Despair is a severe setback

force_powers.description: Force-sensitive characters use the Force through ranked powers with light and dark side options.
force_powers.light_side: Healing, protection, enhancement, telekinesis for defense
force_powers.dark_side: Mind control, force lightning, choke, fear, domination

destiny_tokens.description: A shared pool of light and dark side tokens that players can spend to modify dice pools, driving the narrative.
destiny_tokens.light_side: Spent to add success, advantage, or boost dice
destiny_tokens.dark_side: Spent to add threat, challenge, or despair dice

card_game_mechanics.description: Trading card game with resource management and aspect system

heroism.description: Altruism, healing, and protection of allies

action_phase.description: Players alternate taking actions: play units, events, upgrades, attack with units, or use card abilities. Phase ends when both players pass consecutively.
actions: Play an upgrade on a unit

regroup_phase.description: Draw cards, place resources, and ready exhausted cards.
steps: Draw cards to return hand to starting size
Place one card from hand face-down as a resource
Ready all exhausted cards

card_types.leader: Double-sided key figure; starts as leader, can deploy as unit
card_types.base: Starting structure with ~30 HP; if reduced to 0 HP, player loses
card_types.unit: Characters and vehicles that can attack and defend
card_types.event: One-time effects that resolve when played
card_types.upgrade: Cards attached to units to enhance their abilities

aspect_penalty.description: When playing a card, for each aspect icon on the card not provided by your leader or base, pay 2 extra resources.
